description: The layer_weights and confidence_formula values below reproduce assess_axes()'s former hardcoded Integrity weighting. Version 2 restricts substantive support to evidence tiers independent of the submitter: a cross-evidence check from a signature-validated C2PA manifest or from recorder-written BWF/iXML metadata. Submitter-provided documents (RIN, ERN, CompSheet, CueSheet, MIDI, AAF, sound reports, unverified C2PA) still contribute to the cross_evidence_support value and can reveal contradictions, but cannot release a numeric Integrity value on their own. severe_contradiction_rules/severe_contradiction_cap cap the weighted mean when a severe, near-impossible-to-fake-honestly contradiction is found.

layer_weight_rationale.file_integrity: Hash binding and parser success are the hardest evidence to fabricate convincingly; baseline weight.
layer_weight_rationale.declaration_consistency: Requires matching declared fields to a file the submitter does not control; baseline weight.
layer_weight_rationale.cross_evidence_support: Corroboration from parsed evidence. Each check carries an evidence_tier: signed_attestation (validated C2PA), recorder_metadata (BWF/iXML written into a hash-bound recording) or submitter_document (RIN, ERN, CompSheet, CueSheet, MIDI, AAF, sound reports, unverified C2PA). Baseline weight. physical_similarity is not weightable here because it is policy-disabled (see docs/PHYSICAL_SIMILARITY.md) and never contributes to integrity.
